mechanism: Atomoxetine inhibits norepinephrine reuptake while isocarboxazid is an MAOI, creating risk of hypertensive crisis and sympathomimetic toxicity through excessive noradrenergic stimulation.
action: Avoid concurrent use; isocarboxazid must be discontinued for at least 14 days before starting atomoxetine, or atomoxetine must be stopped for at least 5 days before initiating isocarboxazid.
